_help: Act 2, the caravanserai manager (free): the three roads (Act 3) and the guides (heard_routes). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

start.speaker: abdel
start.line: Welcome. Merchants, guides, camels, horses: if it crosses the desert, it passes through my gate.

menu.speaker: abdel
menu.line: What do you need to know?

choices.label: Ask about the roads
choices.line: How do I get west, to the empty country?

roads.speaker: abdel
roads.line: Three ways. Across the sand on horseback: fastest, but horses cost money. Upriver on Captain Hamdi's boat: cheapest, if you like company. Or the long coast road by truck, slow but kind.

guides.speaker: abdel
guides.line: Saleh al-Rashidi, if you want to come home. Young Youssef, if you are in a hurry. Farid Mansour, if you want to eat well on the way.
